8212.title: Shared close-control geometry and title-bar sizing
8212.rootCauseOneLine: The macOS descendant button-height rule overrides the square close control to 16x28px; the shared close element also couples its painted surface to its hit target.

prReviews.verdict: Static approach addresses the confirmed cause; runtime fix not verified
prReviews.topFinding: The diff excludes the close button from title-bar height sizing and separates hover paint from the hit target. Its tests do not measure browser layout.

8212.proposedFix: Exclude the nested close control from title-bar button height sizing and keep a centered inset visual surface separate from the enlarged touch hit target. Validate computed browser geometry.
8212.caveats: The macOS hover defect reproduces twice. Pure coarse-pointer touch reports hover:none, so its background remains transparent; touch hover clipping itself is not reproduced. Existing linked open PR 8213 prevents a duplicate fix PR. Isolated production components and compiled application CSS were tested, not the complete app.
